title: Read a transform-select-fold pipeline
description: You follow the supplied score processing through named stages and a composed expression.

steps.description: You add five to each score while capping the result at 100. Materializing map with list gives the printed curved values.
You select curved values at least 70 and fold them into a total starting from zero. The supplied mean of those selected values prints as 87.7.

steps.question: Does the final maximum calculation receive scores or curved?
steps.answer: It receives the original scores list. Its comparison chooses the larger value at each reduction step.

steps.description: You see the composed pipeline print 526 and the original-score maximum print 95. The composed expression uses the same transformation and selection as the earlier stages.
